newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis rejects Giscard call for Ffr depreciation.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis rejects Giscard call for Ffr depreciation.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis on Thursday rejected a call by former president Valery Giscard d'Estaing for a sharp depreciation of the franc, the afternoon daily Le Monde said.
"The best currency parities are those which give the lowest interest rates. When the franc weakens, interest rates rise," Le Monde quoted him as saying.
It said Arthuis did not mention Giscard d'Estaing by name but he "made it clear the government had no intention whatsoever of changing monetary policy".
He also repeated that the dollar had room to rise. "I have always said that the dollar has a margin for appreciation," it quoted him as saying.
